**7 continents.**

The standard model taught worldwide recognizes these seven:

- Africa
- Antarctica
- Asia
- Europe
- North America
- South America
- Australia (often called Oceania when including surrounding islands)

Some models differ (e.g., 6 by combining Europe+Asia into Eurasia, or 5 by also merging North+South America), but 7 is the most widely accepted convention.
